question: For each match, considering every innings, please combine runs from both batsman scored and extra runs for each over, then identify the single over with the highest total runs, retrieve the bowler for that over from the ball by ball table, and calculate the average of these highest over totals across all matches, ensuring that all runs and bowler details are accurately reflected.
sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.over_id,
        m.innings_no,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball m
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON m.match_id = bs.match_id AND m.over_id = bs.over_id AND m.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND m.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON m.match_id = er.match_id AND m.over_id = er.over_id AND m.ball_id = er.ball_id AND m.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.over_id, m.innings_no
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        over_id,
        SUM(total_runs) as combined_over_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id
),
max_over_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        over_id,
        combined_over_runs as highest_over_total
    FROM over_totals
    WHERE combined_over_runs = (
        SELECT MAX(ct2.combined_over_runs) 
        FROM over_totals ct2 
        WHERE ct2.match_id = over_totals.match_id
    )
    AND (match_id, over_id) IN (
        SELECT match_id, MIN(over_id) as min_over_id
        FROM over_totals
        WHERE combined_over_runs = (
            SELECT MAX(ct3.combined_over_runs) 
            FROM over_totals ct3 
            WHERE ct3.match_id = over_totals.match_id
        )
        GROUP BY match_id
    )
),
bowler_info AS (
    SELECT 
        m.match_id,
        m.over_id,
        m.highest_over_total,
        bb.bowler
    FROM max_over_per_match m
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON m.match_id = bb.match_id AND m.over_id = bb.over_id AND bb.ball_id = 1 AND bb.innings_no = 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(highest_over_total), 4) as average_highest_over_total,
    COUNT(*) as match_count
FROM bowler_info
